static_traits.name: Han Na
static_traits.social_status: Having a group of close friends to play golf with, but not yet discussing this Fear with them
static_traits.medical_history: Never experienced similar psychological problems; never received other psychotherapy; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Expresses herself clearly and can concretely describe worries and assumptions; fairly cooperative and willing to try homework and reality testing

basic_info.main_problem: I fear that if I keep pets other than betta fish, I might accidentally let it Death, which pains me greatly.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling, because this Fear of unintentionally harming pets is starting to affect my daily functioning and decisions.
growth_experiences: About a year ago experienced a negative incident while with a previous pet, since then the sense of responsibility for pet care triggered Moderate stress; the problem gradually developed into avoiding keeping other pets and constantly worrying about their safety, with Fear and worry appearing almost daily when talking about pets or animal care.

core_beliefs: I am unable to properly care for pets (I am not reliable enough)
One mistake from me will cause serious consequences

special_situations.event: Thinking about getting a new pet (not a betta fish) or seeing others discuss keeping pets
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot achieve zero mistakes, pets will get hurt or Death
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding keeping pets other than betta fish; constantly rehearsing worst-case scenarios in mind to 'guard against' them
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will accidentally let it die / I will definitely mess up

special_situations.event: Recalls a negative experience with an old pet a year ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One mistake means I will make the same mistake again in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Inferring the future from one past failure, proactively avoiding similar situations (not keeping other pets again)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Since it happened before, it will happen this time too

special_situations.event: When talking with friends or others about pet/animal care topics
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I reveal this Fear, others will think I am strange, will not understand me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Not bringing up related topics with friends, staying Silence to avoid being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am strange / will not understand me

special_situations.event: Recalls that past pets were also healthy and happy, but negative memories keep occupying the mind
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Negative experiences better indicate real risk, positive experiences do not matter
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Overly attends to potential risk signals, ignores and belittles positive evidence
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The good ones do not count, the bad ones are what matter

core_conflict.wish: Longs to keep pets with peace of mind and become a reliable caregiver, maintaining safety and control over life
core_conflict.fear: Fearing one's mistakes will cause pets to be hurt or Death, thus triggering Strong guilt and self-blame
defense_goal: Maintaining security and reducing Anxiety through avoidance
Maintains high control and caution to reduce the chance of making mistakes

object_relations.self_representation: An unreliable caregiver who may cause harm
object_relations.object_representation: A fragile living being that needs protection and is easily hurt (a pet)

object_relations.self_representation: An outsider worrying about being judged
object_relations.object_representation: Others (friends) who may not understand or think one strange

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When counseling focuses on mistake topics like 'possibly forgetting to feed, not noticing illness'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equating a slip with catastrophic consequences, seeing oneself as a potential harm-doer (transference: self-deprecation)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: A gentle and supportive tone, invites the client to return to concrete experiences and emotional feelings, reducing abstract explanations; uses open-ended questions to guide the client to describe the feelings and bodily reactions at the time.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about sharing this fear with friends or worrying about others' reactions
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Assuming others will think one strange or not understand (transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintain Empathy and non-judgment, use Clarification and validation techniques; softly encourage distinguishing assumptions from evidence, suggest trying small sharing steps and recording actual feedback.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked about the choice of 'not keeping other pets' and its reasons
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Providing seemingly reasonable Interpretations for avoidance behavior to ease Anxiety
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Keep a neutral steady tone, affirming their Self-protection intent, while gently challenging their reasoning chain; inviting cost-benefit analysis and reality testing.

manifestations: Persistently worrying pets will Death due to one's mistakes
Negative memories dominate the perception of life's fragility
outcomes: Avoiding keeping pets other than betta fish
Long-term Anxiety and worry, restricted decisions

manifestations: Anxiety and uncertainty about caregiving responsibility
When deciding whether to keep a pet, feels pressure about bearing the consequences
outcomes: Hesitation and avoidance; narrowed range of behavioral choices

manifestations: Not yet sharing Fear with close friends, worrying about being misunderstood or seen as strange
outcomes: Lacking external support and calibrating information, the Anxiety cycle going uncorrected

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Believing friends will think one strange or not understand, thus unwilling to talk about Fear
Attributes inner shame and worry to others' possible reactions

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: Overly cautious and self-harsh about the possibility of care mistakes
When talking about pets and responsibility, repeatedly self-checks and imagines mistakes

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Demanding oneself with the standards of 'must not make mistakes' 'must have zero errors'
Treating 'no mistake in caregiving is acceptable' as an absolute rule

positive_force: Loves animals, motivated to have pets
Once had times when a pet was healthy and happy, evidence of some caregiving ability
Has a group of close friends (potential social support)
Actively seeks counseling, willing to practice reality testing and homework
negative_force: Significant cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, predicting the future, mental filtering
Zero tolerance for mistakes and high control needs, worsening Anxiety and avoidance
Avoidance behaviors (not keeping other pets, not talking about Fear with friends) maintaining the problem cycle
Self-doubt and worry about being judged, limiting help-seeking behavior

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Anxiety and avoidance toward keeping pets
antecedent: Thinks of getting a new pet or encountering discussions related to pet care
Recalling the negative pet experience from a year ago
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative pet-keeping experiences triggering catastrophic beliefs that mistakes will lead to serious consequences and Strong guilt Anticipation, forming high vigilance about responsibility
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential danger and guilt, maintaining a sense of control and safety
target_behavior.consequence: Avoiding keeping pets other than betta fish; daily decisions restricted; persistent worry and not discussing this Fear with friends

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly predicts the worst case and worries excessively (rumination)
antecedent: When asked about pet-raising plans or hearing pet care topics
Thinking alone about possible care mistakes
target_behavior.core_reason: Certain assumptions about future mistakes and overgeneralization leading to sustained threat monitoring
target_behavior.function: Trying to gain control through rehearsing risks, reducing uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety maintained or worsened, difficulty conducting reality testing and small-step attempts
